static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: Good relationship with friends, but not easy to open up about this fear
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past; no experience of receiving psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, high cooperativeness, able to self-reflect; positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I have always had a persistent thought: because I am an only child, I will eventually die lonely with no one to care for me.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this persistent thought is affecting my mental health and bringing pain, so I seek counseling; I need help to cope with and relieve this thought's impact on me.
growth_experiences: An only child since young, with no siblings. In recent years this identity has gradually triggered worries about lacking a future support system; when seeing close families or during holidays, this worry is reinforced, followed by anxiety and sadness.

core_beliefs: I am destined to die alone
No one will truly care for me

special_situations.event: Seeing intimate families together or family gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no siblings or blood-tie support, no one will care for me in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention with hobbies, avoids such scenes and topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will eventually have no one to care for me, dying lonely

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Having no family company during festivals means I have no support system
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not opening up to friends to avoid becoming a burden; shifting attention

special_situations.event: Thinking about being an only child
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Having siblings equals safety and being cared for; having none means destined loneliness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shifting attention away, not thinking about or discussing related content

special_situations.event: Recalls the support and companionship friends once gave
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Non-blood-tie support is unreliable; friends ultimately cannot care for me at critical moments
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Dismissing and belittling existing evidence of support
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Friends are here now, but will not show up when I need them in the future

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be continuously cared for and looked after, with a stable and reliable support relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being isolated, with no one understanding or caring for me; worrying that exposing vulnerability will be judged as exaggeration or becoming a burden
defense_goal: Avoiding revealing fear to family and friends to reduce the risk of being rejected / judged
Suppressing loneliness and fear through distraction
Maintaining surface independence to preserve a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: An individual who may be neglected and eventually lonely / a potential burden
object_relations.object_representation: Others are unreliable or do not understand me, possibly thinking I am making a fuss over nothing

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to consider sharing this specific fear with a close friend
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying others will think I am exaggerating and be burdened by my problems, thus unwilling to open up
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle tone, prioritizing empathy and validation, using open-ended questions and small-step strategies, encouraging evaluation of potential benefits and boundaries, without pressuring.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the session focuses on the theme of 'only child = lonely aging'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to discuss problems through abstract reasoning, reducing emotional involvement to avoid discomfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keeping a steady, empathetic tone, slowing the pace, inviting them to attend to present bodily and emotional feelings, helping them connect with emotions within a bearable range.

manifestations: Worrying about dying lonely with no one to care for me as an only child
Strong loneliness triggered by seeing close families or during holidays
Not daring to open up about this fear to friends, afraid of becoming a burden or being misunderstood

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Carefully restraining from speaking up for fear friends will think I am making a fuss or becoming a burden
Repeatedly self-assessing whether I would 'disturb others' when discussing sensitive topics

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning the urge to seek support into self-repression and digestion (distracting with hobbies)
Choosing to bear it alone rather than seek help when needing comfort

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding direct contact with thoughts of 'lonely aging' through distraction and shifting attention
Quickly changing the topic or moving away from related scenes in triggering situations

positive_force: Has a few close and supportive friends
Has self-awareness and expressive ability, can describe thoughts and emotions
Actively seeking help and starting counseling
Positive attitude, willing to try reality testing and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Tendency toward catastrophizing and predicting the future
Dismissing existing positive support (dismissing the positive)
Mental filtering, over-focusing on evidence of lacking siblings
In an all-or-nothing way, equates 'having siblings or not' with 'being cared for or not'
Avoiding asking others for help, worrying about becoming a burden and being evaluated

target_behavior.behavior: Recurring catastrophic / predictive thoughts ('because I am an only child, I will age lonely with no one to care for me'), accompanied by anxiety and sadness
antecedent: Thinking of being an only child and future old age
target_behavior.core_reason: Deep fear of loneliness and losing the support system, rigidly equating 'only child' with 'no one to care for me'
target_behavior.function: Gaining a false sense of control over the uncertain future by repeatedly predicting the worst outcomes, and temporarily lowering anxiety through avoidance
target_behavior.consequence: Frequent anxiety and sadness, affecting daily life

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing fears with close friends / seeking support
antecedent: When thinking about discussing the fear with friends
When others suggest sharing feelings or seeking help
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being seen as exaggerating or troubling others; fearing being rejected or negatively evaluated
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential shame and rejection experiences, maintaining a sense of safety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Missing external support and corrective experiences, maintaining loneliness and helplessness
